text: Lookout turns a spare phone into a camera for your coding agent.
The phone hangs on an arm, looking straight down at the board.
So you ask the agent what the blinking LED means.
The agent looks through the phone, and sees the LED is out of frame.
It asks you to move the board, and waits until you tap Ready.
Then it records six seconds at sixty frames per second, and reads the blink code from the brightness.
Three long, two short: a brown-out reset.
Before it answers, it asks you one question on the phone.
The battery sags when the radio transmits. The fix: power the board from USB.
You plug in the USB cable, and the LED stays a steady green.
Lookout. Your coding agent can see your desk.
